content: Bhula yinguanogha kutama bhala bhaanhyubhalila Kilisito
Ghubhatende bhandu bhakulungwe kukita bhangunoghwa abhatekule atabhala na bhaabheghiti na makakala, bhabhayitikile na bhabhe kala kutenda milando ya maha yoha.
Ghubhaghombele bhakotoke kunligha mundu ywohele, ngati bhakotoke kulimbana, na abheghe nuu, na paakibhoneha utetebhalo kwa bhandu bhoha mumanjubha ghoha.

Kiyaha manjubha ghamu twenga tukibhegha abhughabhugha, angakatala na ahokelo. Tukibhegha abhandwa bha tama na kubejula ghweka. Tukitama muubhumi ghwa uhokelo na malili, bhandu bhakitukalila na twenga tukibhakalalila.
Peni paghuhwimulitwe umaha na upalo ghwake Chapanga na Nlopohi ghwetu,

kakitulopoha, na kakitenda habho chepa kwa nnando ghwohele ghwa maha ghutuutendite ngati kwa luhungu lwake, kwa njila ya Nhuki ghwa Chapanga ywakatunemelite kwa kutuyoha ngati tubhelekwe uhyono na tubheghe na ulami ghwa hyono.
Chapanga kakitupegha Nhuki ghwake kwa utekulo kwa kukindila Yesu Kilisito, Nlopohi ghwetu,
ngati kwa umaha ghwake tumokole kuyitikilwa na tunoghwe kuhala ubhumi ghwa manjubha ghoha ghutughuudumbila.

Ali ndo lilagho lya kuhyubhalila. Nungupala ghubhahunde kwa kubhinilila milando ayi, ngati bhala bhaanhyubhalila Chapanga bhahotole kubhegha na kilyakalyaka kya kutenda gha maha. Milando ayi ndo ya maha kangi yibhegha na utopelo kwa bhandu bhoha.
Peni ghuhepetuke na malimbano ya kihila mahala, maghombano gha kya lukolo, bhulwa na malimbano gha kya malaghilo. Milando ayi yibhegha ng'obhe na fwambulo na yibhegha ng'obhe na utopelo ghwohele.
Mundu ywakayambuha nng'abhaniko ghunkinye pakatandila, na ghunkinye paubhili na handa kaayihwa ng'obhe, ghulekani naywo.
Kiyaha ghungumanya kukita mundu handa aywo kahobha na ulemwa ghwake ghungubhoneha kukita kalitosa mwene.
Kamu panunnaghila Alitema ebu Tikiko kwa ghwenga, ghulopokele kuhika kunnola akwo Nikopoli, kiyaha namula kutama akwo mu manjubha gha nndaluko ghwa kipepo.
Ghukakalike kuntangatila nsomi ghwa malaghilo Zenasi na Apolo, ngati ahotole kuyanda mwanja ghwabhe, na ghulyaghile akotoke kupelelwa kubhegha na kilibhi kyoheli kyabhakipalite.
Bhandu bhetu nabho bhalihunde kutenda gha maha, ngati bhabhatangatile bhaabheghite na upalo ghwa hilibhi hyaahipala ngati akotoke kutama ubhumi ghwa nga kutangatila.
Bhandu bhoha bhaabheghite papamu na nenga bhangughujambuha. Ghubhajambuhe bhala bhoha bhaatupala. Nungubhayupila mabhoha umaha ghwa Chapanga.
